Name: Kenneth's Classic Potions
Author: Kf29
Description:
[size=4][b]Kenneth's Classic Potions[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]15 classic potions for Kenneth's Potion Shop. Azure, ember, and golden looks, in a simple, old-school bottle.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]What you get[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]15 potions in Shop5, all with that simple, classic feel. Some are light and calm for a quick trip, some are steady for a longer day out, and a few are the kind you save for a long day. Classic potions are in there, in azure, skysong, earthen, deepwood, meadow, ember, rosette, dusk violet, ruby, and golden looks, plus emerald, amber, crimson, and venom looks for the special ones.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Check Shop5 in game when you have time, and see which one fits how you play.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Where to buy[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Kenneth's Potion Shop - Shop5[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Most are gold only. The 4 special ones are gold plus 1 Empty Classic Flask. You can grab the Empty Classic Flask in Shop5 too.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]How to play[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]• Go to Kenneth's Potion Shop, Shop5.[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]• Grab an Empty Classic Flask if you want a special one.[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]• Take a look at what is for sale.[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]• Buy the one you like. Shop only, no quests, no crafting.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]What you need[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]• Stardew Valley 1.6[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]• SMAPI[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]• Content Patcher[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]• Kenneth's Potion Shop - you need this so Shop5 shows up[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]• DSS[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]How to install[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]1. Install SMAPI and Content Patcher first.[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]2. Put this mod in your Mods folder.[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]3. Make sure Kenneth's Potion Shop is also installed.[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]4. Start the game and check Shop5.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Works with other mods?[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Yeah. Works with the other potions from Kenneth's Potion Shop. You can add it in the middle of a save, no need to start a new game.[/b][/size]
